subject: BrightCart POC — Performance recap & quick advocacy check

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Ortiz <daniel.ortiz@brightcart.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@brightcart.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-14T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: BrightCart POC — Performance recap & quick advocacy check

Hi Daniel / Priya,

Thanks again for running the POC with us — really appreciate the partnership. Quick recap from our end (attached slide deck):

- Cost: platform-level inference unit cost down ~48% vs your baseline (token-equivalent units).
- Throughput: sustained serving throughput improved ~3x at your target QPS after batching and KV cache tuning.
- Latency: median tail improvements — median end-to-end inference latency for the ranking pipe moved from ~420ms to ~210ms; p95 is ~480ms under production-like load.
- Business signal: we saw a +7.9% lift in click-through rate on personalized recommendations during the A/B window (stat sig, p<.05).

We've put those metrics on slide 2 of the attached PDF and a short draft release language in the Word doc. Would you be open to:

1) A 20-minute call this week to review a one-line quote and attribution (we'll keep it short), and
2) Permission to publish a brief case snippet with the metrics above and BrightCart logo?

If helpful, proposed times: Wed 10/21 11:00am PT or Thu 10/22 9:00am PT. If neither works, tell me a good slot and we'll adapt.

Attachments: brightcart_poc_kpi_slide.pdf (3 slides), advocate_release_draft.docx (1-page draft)

Best,
Mina

Mina Haddad
